text: ＊コ　すてても　よろしいですか？

structure.jp: すてても　よろしいですか？
structure.en: is it all right to throw away?

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.span: すてても　よろしいですか
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus も and a word for 'good' asks or says that doing something is OK. よろしい is a more polite いい. すてても　よろしいですか = 'is it OK to throw away?'
